findings.claim: 美國政府占 FY2025 合併營收約 68%（FY2024 76%、FY2023 75%）；無單一非政府客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, the U.S. Government represented approximately 68%, 76% and 75% of our total consolidated revenues, respectively. No individual non-U.S. Government customer accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated revenues in the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 or 2023.

findings.claim: 四家大型公用事業客戶占 FY2025 營收約 17%（14%、14%）；其應收占淨應收 50%（前一年 19%）；美政府直接/間接應收占 28%（前一年 40%）。
findings.excerpt: revenues from four large utility customers accounted for approximately 17%, 14% and 14% of our total consolidated revenues, respectively. Accounts receivable due directly from four large utility customers represented 50% and 19% of net receivables at December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

findings.claim: 報導稱 Moody's 於 2026-10 將 BWXT 展望由穩定調為正向、確認 Ba1 發行人評等（二手德文報導，未核 Moody's 原文）。
findings.source: Börse-Express：BWX Technologies Aktie: Moody's hebt Ausblick an
findings.excerpt: Medienberichten zufolge hob die Agentur am Montag den Ausblick für den US-Konzern von zuvor stabil auf positiv an.

note: 本軸僅搜尋 1 次；2026 查無降評或下修財測的來源；Moody's 一則來自二手報導。
